title: Deciphering Moiré Periodicity Modification in van der Waals Heterostructure
content: The field of 2D materials is actively exploring property tailoring through moiré effects that arise when different lattices interact, presenting vast research opportunities. The new periodicity introduced by moiré patterns gives rise to properties that do not exist in the original materials. Consequently, variations in moiré arrangements due to lattice mismatch and lattice twist angle, as well as different moiré points arising from parallel and anti-parallel stacking configurations, all contribute to changes in electronic and optical properties [1]. Thus, a detailed examination of moiré distribution is essential for property measurement and device applications.
